# GetGlobex

> GetGlobex (getglobex.com) is an AI supplier-matching platform for US importers. Tell us the product you need, and we shortlist suppliers worldwide that are already shipping it to the US. Know your HS code? Add it. It's free to request a match.

GetGlobex (getglobex.com) is an AI supplier-matching platform. We are not a broker, and we don't offer forex, CFD or investment products.

## How we differ

- Catalogs list millions of sellers. GetGlobex shortlists the few already shipping your product to the US.
- Not a trader, not an agent: buyers and suppliers deal directly, with no paid ranking.
- Built for small and mid-size US importers. Any product, suppliers worldwide.
- Not a product catalog: you don't scroll through listings. You describe what you need and get a short list.
- Evidence: we look at public US customs and import records (for example, bill of lading records). That is a signal, not a certification.
- We're matching first in furniture & home furnishings and plastic packaging & household products; any product is welcome.

## Key facts

- Buyers: describe your product to request a match. Know your HS code? Add it. If you're not sure of it, the official US tariff schedule is at https://hts.usitc.gov/.
- Suppliers: create a supplier profile with the products you make.
- Request a free match: it's free to request.
- GetGlobex is not a trading company. We don't buy, sell or hold goods.
- GetGlobex doesn't publish ratings, testimonials, certifications, ESG scores, supplier counts or sales figures.
- The match request, supplier profile and contact forms don't store or send anything yet.

## Languages

- English is the main language of getglobex.com. Five pages are also available in Spanish for Mexico (/es/). All other pages are in English only.
- Each translated page links to its English version with hreflang. The English page is the default.
